visibleEditorialCopy.description: In Kiyoshi Kurosawa's unsettling crime mystery, a frustrated detective investigates a string of gruesome murders carried out by everyday people who retain no memory of committing the acts.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Heavy, immersive psychological dread with a measured investigative rhythm, suited for focused solitary viewing.
